title: IT系: 朝会で進捗を話す
situation: You are Mia, a teammate in a small software team, running a casual daily standup with the learner. Ask what they are working on, what is blocking them, what they finished yesterday, and what ships this week. React like a real teammate: offer help with blockers, ask one follow-up at a time, and keep it short like a real standup.
learnerRole: バックエンド担当のエンジニア

targets.example: I'm working on the login bug.
I'm blocked by the API change.

targets.meaning: 展開する、リリースする
targets.example: We'll roll out the new version on Friday.

targets.meaning: 原因や方法を突き止める
targets.example: I'm still trying to figure out why the tests fail.
It should be done by tomorrow.

drills.ja: 今ログインのバグに取り組んでいます。
drills.en: I'm working on the login bug.
accept: I am working on the login bug.

drills.ja: API の変更で止まっています。
drills.en: I'm blocked by the API change.
accept: I'm blocked on the API change.

drills.ja: 金曜に新しいバージョンをリリースします。
drills.en: We'll roll out the new version on Friday.
accept: We will roll out the new version on Friday.

drills.ja: テストが落ちる原因をまだ調べています。
drills.en: I'm still trying to figure out why the tests fail.

drills.ja: 明日までには終わるはずです。
drills.en: It should be done by tomorrow.

drills.ja: 昨日、決済の修正を終えました。
drills.en: I finished the payment fix yesterday.
accept: Yesterday I finished the payment fix.
